[COURSEWORK / PROJECT SUMMARY]{.eyebrow}

## The question

What should a measurement plan establish before a team interprets outcomes?

## Approach

The analytics blueprint organizes measurement questions, evidence needs, and interpretation boundaries for the PhD Orthodontics project. It is a planning contribution within coursework.

## What this work demonstrates

A blueprint proposes how to measure; it does not prove that events fire correctly or that qualified leads have been recorded. The client GA4 property/tag mismatch requires correction and validation before trustworthy prospective measurement.
